control_audit: Original tokenizer decides phrase polarity in both arms; phrase identities asserted equal by runner. Pools/caps/scoring unchanged. Prior pre-polarity-fix file retained; model agent verified unchanged top10 outputs after correction. Snowball is not asserted to be exact Lucene parity.

overall.decision: Keep morphological equivalence as an observed useful mechanism; reject current universal stemmed ranker. Stop this bounded prototype loop with no global winner.
overall.assessment: Normalization has real gains: Arrival communication, restaurant workplace and medical dry humor. It also creates material car-pursuit subject failures and does not repair joint aliens. Original13 local overhead stays under50ms in this run, but supplemental and joint outliers exceed the target. Evidence does not justify a universal replacement or query-specific exception. Distinct cheap mechanisms and refinements have now produced an understandable tradeoff frontier; further arbitrary weights/combinations lack a supported general improvement hypothesis. This is practical exhaustion of the tested prototype scope, not proof all algorithms are exhausted.
overall.retained: Separately validated conservative catalog-identity cleanup; useful original cheap controls remain selectable. No interpretation prompt or universal route accepted.
